title: Hogwarts Legacy
provenance: Reported working by WaterWANG-1014 (highball-db#48, 2026-09-15), Apple M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7, Highball 0.9.19 with the corrected DirectX 12 shim, D3DMetal, launches and runs. Not verified by the maintainer. Also reported by amoslanz44 (highball-db#80, 2026-09-16), Apple M5, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, D3DMetal, Epic copy, rated 5 of 5 after 7 minutes.
notes: DirectX 12 only, so D3DMetal. Before Highball 0.9.19 it stopped at "Failed to initialize DirectX 12" on every Mac: the timestamp shim in front of D3DMetal's d3d12.dll numbered its exports from 1 and the game asks for D3D12CreateDevice by ordinal 101, so it never got a device (highball-db#48, the same bug as Path of Exile 2). Fixed in the engines shipped with 0.9.19 (r3 and r9). Do not add -dx11, the game refuses two graphics API flags and crashes at start. The recipe still advertises AVX to the game, it was on in the working run and whether it is needed is not known. A second report on an M5 with macOS 26 rates it perfect on D3DMetal, Epic copy.

knownIssues.symptom: "Failed to initialize DirectX 12" a few seconds after launch on D3DMetal, no crash, no log (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: measured: the DirectX 12 timestamp shim exported its functions numbered from 1 and the game binds D3D12CreateDevice by ordinal 101
knownIssues.fix: Highball 0.9.19 and its engines r3 and r9. Confirmed by the reporter

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at second zero at fixed addresses when -dx11 is among the Steam launch options
knownIssues.cause: measured from the crash context: the game adds its own DirectX 12 flag and Unreal refuses two graphics API flags
